t1.text: Share cards — five types, Night style, shown at half scale (1080 → 540)

s5.text: Season: the listening-rhythm ring and verdict over the rolling 90 days, plus the metals earned. Unlocks at the same 20-play threshold as the profile card; the verdict stays a sentence, never a shouted label.

s1.text: Now Playing: shared from the player. Fixes the crowding: the title gets its own band, the clock sits under the line instead of inside the chip row, and chips wrap to a second row rather than squeezing. Record peeks from behind the jacket in its real pressing.

s2.text: Record: shared from a record sheet / gatefold. One record only — pressing name, finish, sleeve note, the thin rating as decoration, and the friends sticker when it applies.

s3.text: Pressings: the collection card. Each tile is the pressing disc with its record's cover tucked behind it, so the variant and the album read together. 12 tiles, newest first; the header counts the rest.

s4.text: Crate: slimmed to what it's good at — top albums and top songs. Metals, the collection row and the listening-rhythm verdict all leave this card (they had been causing the bunching).
